DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The clinical presentation of a "continuous machinery" murmur (Patent Ductus Arteriosus), bilateral congenital cataracts (eye involvement), and hearing loss (deafness), combined with a positive Rubella IgM serology, confirms this diagnosis. This triad represents the classic "3 C's" of congenital rubella.
